experiment: NC1 — Newtonian-closure gate (G-Newton) on a sheared particle arrangement
status: pre-registered before any physics run of nc1_run.py (no exploratory runs; a pure timing benchmark may precede the run and is not an outcome)
gate_under_test: docs/fluid-dynamics §6 [GATE] G-Newton: interaction stress of the arrangement reduces to sigma = -p I + 2 eta D with eta obtained FROM the arrangement; and §3 vs §6 placement of the Newtonian regime relative to the isostatic margin (z = 2d, phi_J)
question: Does a particle arrangement, with only pair contacts + a declared dissipation mechanism, produce a Newtonian shear stress with a finite viscosity; where (relative to phi_J) does that regime live; and is eta a material property (same value by two independent routes)?
reduction: 2-D is the allowed reduction of 3-D (d = 2, isostatic z_iso = 2d = 4, phi_J ~ 0.84 for 2-D bidisperse disks)

model_A_athermal_overdamped.particles: N = 512 bidisperse soft disks, 50:50, radii 0.5 and 0.7 (diameter ratio 1.4), harmonic contact U = (k/2) delta^2, k = 1
model_A_athermal_overdamped.dynamics: overdamped mean-field drag (Durian RD0 / Olsson-Teitel): dr_i/dt = gdot*y_i xhat + F_i/zeta, zeta = 1, Euler dt = 0.1
model_A_athermal_overdamped.stress: contact virial sigma_xy = -(1/L^2) sum_{i<j} r_ij,x f_ij,y (positive for resistance to positive shear); eta = sigma_xy/gdot
model_A_athermal_overdamped.strain: transient 1.0 discarded, then 2.0 measured (3.0 total); 10 blocks for error bars

model_B_thermal_inertial.purpose: P4 needs fluctuations/momentum; model A has no momentum conservation or temperature, so the two-route test is done in a thermal inertial liquid of the same disks
model_B_thermal_inertial.particles: same disks, m = 1, k = 1, phi = 0.70, T = 0.01, N = 512, velocity-Verlet dt = 0.05
model_B_thermal_inertial.route_1_NEMD: SLLOD + Lees-Edwards, isokinetic rescaling of peculiar momenta; P_xy incl. kinetic term; eta1 = -P_xy/gdot at gdot in [0.002, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02]; eta_NEMD = mean of the two lowest rates
model_B_thermal_inertial.route_2_periodic_perturbation: NO Lees-Edwards, NO stress measured: body acceleration A cos(k y) xhat, k = 2 pi/L, profile-unbiased isokinetic thermostat; eta2 = rho A /(V k^2) from the steady velocity-profile amplitude V (momentum-diffusion route). A in [0.002, 0.004]; eta_PP = mean
model_B_thermal_inertial.runs: equilibrate 500 time units, measure 5000 time units (NEMD) and transient 500 + 5000 (PP)

model_C_control_inertial_athermal.purpose: control on WHICH dissipation gives Newtonian: athermal inertial disks with pair normal damping b = 1 (no drag, no temperature), SLLOD = Newton in lab frame + Lees-Edwards

predictions.P1_newtonian_below_phiJ: model A, phi in {0.70, 0.75, 0.80}: power-law fit sigma ~ gdot^n over the three lowest rates gives |n - 1| <= 0.10, and eta at the two lowest rates agree within 20% (finite plateau eta)
predictions.P2_eta_diverges_toward_phiJ: model A, eta(phi) := sigma/gdot at the lowest rate, phi in {0.70, 0.75, 0.78, 0.80, 0.82}: (a) strictly increasing, (b) eta(0.82)/eta(0.70) >= 10, (c) fit eta = A (phi_c - phi)^(-beta) gives phi_c in [0.82, 0.88] and beta > 0
predictions.P3_yield_above_phiJ: model A, phi in {0.85, 0.86}: local exponent d ln sigma / d ln gdot between the two lowest rates <= 0.5, and Herschel-Bulkley fit sigma = sigma_y + K gdot^n gives sigma_y > 0 by > 3 standard errors (not Newtonian)
predictions.P5_control_bagnold: model C (exploratory, does not gate NC1): flow index n over all four rates in [1.7, 2.3] (Bagnold sigma ~ gdot^2), i.e. Newtonian is NOT generic to arrangements — it needs a viscous or thermal dissipation channel

also_reported_not_gated: mean contact number z per phi (compare with z_iso = 4), pressure p, eta_NEMD rate dependence, finite-k caveat of route 2
grading: all results are [V mech]: in-model mechanism checks, not a derivation of Navier-Stokes for any real fluid or for the VP vacuum
runtime_budget: <= 15 min on 4 cores; if the budget is exceeded, N or measured strain may be reduced and the deviation is logged in RESULT.json (predictions and thresholds are frozen)
